# Crew API: schedules (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## GET /v1/crew/schedules

List this grant's schedules.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `schedules:manage`. The app also needs the entitlement `schedules.manage`. |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no | Start after this id. |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 100, default `20`) | no |  |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [ScheduleList](schemas.md#schedulelist):

| `first_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `last_id` | string or null | no |  |
| `has_more` | boolean | yes |  |

## POST /v1/crew/schedules

Create a schedule.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `schedules:manage`. The app also needs the entitlement `schedules.manage`. |

Each run spends credits against the same grant quota; when quota is short the run is skipped and last_run.status=skipped_quota.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [CreateScheduleRequest](schemas.md#createschedulerequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `model` | string | yes | The agent id of this app's capability bundle, or a Bot id the grant allows. With a Bot, every trigger runs under the rules for conversations that use a Bot as the model. |
| `message` | string | yes |  |
| `schedule` | [ScheduleSpec](schemas.md#schedulespec) | yes |  |
| `conversation` | string | no | Run in an existing conversation; omit to start a new one each time. |

Response `201`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |

| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [Schedule](schemas.md#schedule):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `object` | `schedule` | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `model` | string | no |  |
| `message` | string | no |  |
| `schedule` | [ScheduleSpec](schemas.md#schedulespec) | yes |  |
| `status` | `active`, `paused` | yes |  |
| `next_run_at` | integer or null | no |  |
| `last_run` | object or null | no |  |

## POST /v1/crew/schedules/{schedule_id}/run

| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `schedules:manage`. The app also needs the entitlement `schedules.manage`. |
